description:
Part 1 of 3: Enzymatic Prep & Ligation
With this protocol, your OT-2 can perform the Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kit. For more information about the Swift 2S Turbo Kit and the Swift 2S Turbo Unique Dual Indexing Primer Kit on the OT-2, please see our Application Note here: Rapid high quality next generation sequencing library preparation with Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kits on the Opentrons OT-2
In this part of the protocol, your OT-2 will complete the enzymatic prep portion and the initial steps of the ligation portion prior to adding your samples to a thermocycler, as described in the Swift 2S Turbo Kit Guide.
At the completion of this step, you will add your samples to the thermocycler. Once the thermocycler step is complete, continue with Part 2 of the protocol.
Links:
 Part 1: Enzymatic Prep & Ligation
 Part 2: Ligation Clean-Up & PCR Prep
* Part 3: Final Clean-Up
Note: This workflow replaces the Reagent K2 in the Enzymatic Prep Master Mix with Reagent DE in order to reduce the risk of over fragmentation. For more information, please see this note.


To purchase consumables, labware, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com
Attention: You can now purchase all of the consumables needed to run this protocol by clicking here.

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later)
Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kit
Swift 2S Turbo Unique Dual Indexing Primer Kit
Omega Mag-Bind TotalPure NGS Kit
Opentrons Temperature Module with Aluminum Block Set
Opentrons Magnetic Module
Opentrons P20 Single-Channel Pipette or Opentrons P50 Single-Channel Pipette*
Opentrons P300 Multi-Channel Pipette
Opentrons Tips
NEST 96-Well PCR Plate
NEST 12-Well Reservoir, 15mL
NEST 2mL Tubes
Samples, resuspended in Low EDTA TE, bringing the total volume to 16µL
PCR Strip(s), optional

*Opentrons now sells the P20 Single-Channel Pipette in place of the P50 Single-Channel Pipette. If you have the P50 Single-Channel Pipette, you can use it for this protocol.
Full setup for the entire protocol:




Specific to Part 1 of 3
Slot 1: NEST 96-Well PCR Plate (or PCR Strips) on top of 96-Well Aluminum Block with samples
 8 Samples: Column 1
 16 Samples: Columns 1 & 2
* 24 Samples: Columns 1, 2, & 3
Slot 3: Opentrons Temperature Module with 24-Well Aluminum Block and NEST 2mL Tubes with master mixes (for more information on master mixes, click here)
 A1: Enzymatic Prep Master Mix
 A2: Ligation Master Mix
 A3: (used in Part 2) PCR Master Mix
 B1: (used in Part 2) Indexing Reagent 1 (in original container); loaded sequentially (Reagent 2 - B2; Reagent 3 - B3...)
Slot 5: Opentrons Tips
Using the customizations fields, below set up your protocol.
 Pipette and Tip Type: Select which pipette (P50 Single-Channel or P20 Single-Channel) and corresponding tips to be used for this protocol. The pipette should be attached to the left mount.
 Number of Samples: Specify the number of samples (8, 16 or 24) you'd like to run.
